svg.aria-label: GitHub profile banner for Niko R. Polistico, software developer from Butuan City, Philippines, and BSIT cum laude graduate of Caraga State University. Shows an ASCII portrait and a terminal-style summary: focus on web systems, databases and applied AI; stack includes Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Node.js, Nuxt, Vercel and Hyperledger Fabric; projects a decentralized crime reporting platform, a DTR system, and PaymentsMonitoring.
